title: MedOmni-45°: A Safety–Performance Benchmark for Reasoning-Oriented LLMs in Medicine
reasoning: The term 'faithfulness' in this paper refers to 'Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness,' which is defined as the alignment between a model's internal reasoning steps and its final answer. The benchmark focuses on medical accuracy and robustness against manipulative hints (anti-sycophancy) rather than religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral frameworks.
